ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are two cascaded 4:1 MUXs in the diagram. The select terminals of the left MUX are W and X, and the problem states that W is the MSB of this select pair; I0 and I3 of the left MUX are grounded as 0, and I1 and I2 are connected to Vcc as 1. The output Q of the left MUX is connected to the upper two inputs I0 and I1 of the right MUX. The select terminals of the right MUX are Y and Z, and the problem states that Y is the MSB of this select pair; the lower two inputs I2 and I3 of the right MUX are grounded as 0, and the output is F. Reasoning: The left MUX outputs I0=0 when WX=00, outputs I1=1 when WX=01, outputs I2=1 when WX=10, and outputs I3=0 when WX=11, therefore the left output Q_left = W\bar{X} + \bar{W}X. In the right MUX, when Y=0, regardless of whether Z is 0 or 1, I0 or I1 will be selected, and both are equal to Q_left; when Y=1, I2 or I3 will be selected, and both are 0. Therefore F = \bar{Y} Q_left = \bar{Y}(W\bar{X} + \bar{W}X) = W\bar{X}\bar{Y} + \bar{W}X\bar{Y}.
